about_the_game:
After the apocalypse, it's time to take a break. Take a moment to get out your deck chair and slip on your fins. It will take more than a zombie horde to interrupt your holiday.
With the Holidays Cosmetic Pack, you'll have everything you need to fully enjoy ParadiZe.
The Holidays Cosmetic Pack includes:
- A beach armour set for those who can't swim
- A cosmetic outfit set
- A sailor backpack
- A Zombot pool outfit
- Beach building skins to work on your tan in a seaside atmosphere without worrying about the risks

content_descriptors.notes: This game features violence, blood and gore.
